executive_risk_memo: Across the 2026 observation window (April 9 to finalized block 26,452,563 on November 19, 2026 UTC; Ethereum single-chain TVL = $38,370,897), Pacta's catalog indexes 3F's Solady ERC1967Factory (0x54F862fa0612A8709F6Dec4A7B39AF015CD4E82E) with controllerAddress = null and preflight verdict IMMUTABLE_NO_ADMIN (riskScore = 0), missing nine upgradeable ERC-1967 proxies registered under per-proxy adminOf(proxy) storage. Dual-RPC archive reconstruction (eth.drpc.org and mainnet.gateway.tenderly.co) reveals two repaired control-plane lags (mean MTTR = 99.49 days) alongside one open 156.52-day governance and documentation discrepancy. First, core proxies (Facility 0x4e01..., wJAAA 0x86b4..., wUSCC 0xF458..., and wFalconX 0x4614...) launched under EIP-7702 EOA admin 0xAbff377A... and single-entity Safe 0xA9F5262c... (0s direct upgrades at blocks 25,094,947 and 25,179,894) for 61.12 days until batch migration at block 25,279,807 to 24h Timelock 0xC1abf272... (minDelay = 86,400s). Second, Safe 0xA9F5262c... (3F_ADMIN_PROTECTED; unguarded, 0 modules via getModulesPaginated and GUARD_STORAGE_SLOT = 0x0) operated as a 1-of-1 Safe owned solely by 3F_OWNER (0xC820...) for 137.86 days—including 25 days after the July 31, 2026 Verification Council announcement claiming 2-of-3 co-signatures—until block 25,833,451 added ChainSecurity and Aragon. Third, active FACILITATOR_ROLE proxies MorphoAllocator (0x9BDcb584..., Vault V2 isAllocator = true) and CommitDeposit (0x19189B5c...) still retain 0s direct admin 0xA9F5262c... (upgraded with 0s delay at blocks 25,538,734, 25,545,086, and 26,282,983) contrary to Verification Council docs asserting 24h delay on all deployed code; meanwhile FAC_FUND (0xf1C6...) and 3F_OWNER (0xC820...) delegate scoped calls via Zodiac Roles Modifiers (0x0fDE... and 0xEb4F...). 3FLabs/grunt (54 trailing-12m commits: 48 Solidity, 6 other; 3 engineers, bus factor = 2) demonstrates active engineering, though explorer verification lagged on Timelock and 0x437254... and remains unverified on 0xb8947d... and Timelock-upgraded MorphoFlashLoanRequest 0xC147a1ef....

result.method: Batched JSON-RPC reads pinned to the block hash (EIP-1898); EIP-1967 / EIP-1822 / beacon proxies; capabilities from PUSH4 selectors in proxy + implementation bytecode (heuristic).
result.summary: No proxy (EIP-1967, EIP-1822 or beacon) and no owner(), admin(), authority() or AccessControl admin found: immutable as far as these standard surfaces show.

assessment.method: Live bytecode + storage heuristic at the pinned block, cross-checked with Pacta's RPC-pinned record for 3F (block 26451608).
limits: riskScore (0-100) is a heuristic of the controller type and of pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities read at one block; it is not an audit.

The live check reads EIP-1967 slots, owner(), Safe getThreshold() / getOwners() and TimelockController getMinDelay(); custom role systems, bridge or L2 admin paths and off-chain operations are not resolved.
Documentation is compared only for indexed protocols (catalogMatch), at their pinned block.

upgrade_x402.note: Free tier: 50 pre-flight calls per caller per UTC day (REST and MCP), then $0.01 per call over x402 (HTTP 402, never a dead-end 429). Paid routes below: POST the JSON body with an x402 X-PAYMENT (v1) or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) header.
